replaces: v2, kept for the record in config/emotion_spec_v2.json; item features, congruence features and fusion are identical
reason: SemEval trial selected v2b at t 0.05 as the labelling rule (D47); v2 labelled with the plain v2 rule. Reporting labels only

evidence.rule: D30 (weight, t), D32 (features) in docs/decisions.md; D46, D47, D48, D49 (SemEval validation)

labelling.rule: 6-class group of the max raw score over the 25 non-neutral labels without approval and disapproval if >= t, else neutral (v2b, D38)
labelling.use: reporting and validation only; never a model feature
labelling.caution: Chosen on 250 trial headlines; kappa is fair and the confidence intervals of v2, v2b and v2c overlap, so the data do not separate these rules. Validated on headlines only.

fusion.normalisation: per-impression min-max of base and emotion scores
